advisory.title: Content advisory
lines: This game is about losing a friend to suicide. It contains grief and depictions of depression. It does not depict the act, the method, or the death itself.
Play gently. You can pause any time. The flat will wait.
advisory.lead_in: If you or someone you love is struggling, support is real and reachable:

entries.name: Find A Helpline
entries.detail: Free, confidential support lines, searchable by country.
entries.source: Named as the default international pointer in section 11 of the lore bible. Not independently re-verified in this repository. Confirm the service is still operating before shipping.
